thesis: The speaker argues that significant value creation has shifted to the private markets, where companies generate billions in equity value before going public. He illustrates this by explaining that his firm's strategy involves participating in the long-term compounding of businesses by owning them through early venture rounds and often remaining the largest buyer in their IPOs.
